annotations.title: Generate calendar file for a schedule

description: Use this when the user wants one calendar file (.ics) that adds several different events at once: a course or class schedule, a training program, a conference agenda, match fixtures, or a list of webinars on irregular dates. Takes 1-40 sessions (each with its own start, end or duration, optional title, location and note) plus a shared time zone, location, details, link, organizer name and reminders. Returns one .ics file with one event per session and a dated list of the sessions. Does not make add-to-calendar web links per session, send invitations, or change anyone's calendar. Do not use for an event that repeats on a regular pattern (use generate_calendar_event with recurrence).

calendar_name.description: Name for the schedule, e.g. Spanish A1 evening course. Shown as the calendar name and default title.

description.description: Shared details added to every session, e.g. Bring your workbook.

events.description: 1-40 distinct sessions with their own dates, e.g. [{"title":"Week 1","start":"2027-01-12T18:00","end":"19:30"}].

all_day.description: true for a date-only event, e.g. an exam day.

description.description: Short note for this session, e.g. Quiz on chapter 3.

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes instead of end, e.g. 90.

end.description: Local end time HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, e.g. 19:30. All-day: last day YYYY-MM-DD.

location.description: Location for this session if it differs, e.g. Room 204.

start.description: Local start YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, e.g. 2027-01-12T18:00, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day.

title.description: Session title, e.g. Week 1: Introduction. Default: calendar_name with the session number.

location.description: Default location for every session, e.g. Community Center, Room 2.

organizer_name.description: Optional organizer or teacher name, e.g. Ms. Rivera.

reminders_minutes_before.description: Up to 3 reminders for every session, minutes before, e.g. [60].

time_zone.description: Time zone for all sessions: IANA zone or city, e.g. America/Chicago. Required when sessions have times.

url.description: Optional shared link, e.g. a course page or video-call link: https://example.com/course.

name: generate_event_series
title: Generate calendar file for a schedule
